description:
This process begins with identifying an employee's development needs or career aspirations.
The manager and HR create a personal development plan, which may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.
The employee keeps working on skill enhancement while receiving feedback and evaluation from supervisors.
Once certain milestones are reached, the employee is considered for a promotion or new role.
HR conducts a formal review of performance, and if approved, the promotion is finalized with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments.
The process ends when the employee is promoted and transitions into the new role.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_EmployeeDevelopment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ManagerHR" name="Manager and HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DevelopmentNeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MilestonesReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnhanceSkills</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TransitionToNewRole</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Promoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisors" name="Supervisors">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeedIdentified" name="Development need or career aspiration identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>The plan may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Continue development and evaluation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Enhance skills"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate" name="Provide feedback and evaluate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Development and evaluation complete"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole" name="Consider for promotion or new role"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewPerformance" name="Review performance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Promotion approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Transition to new role"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToPlan" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSkills" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkillsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackAndEvaluate" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToMilestones" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestonesToConsideration" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderationToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotionOrRole" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Promotion is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalizeToTransition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
